politicas.qual:
((bucket_id <> 'capi-amrigs-private'::text) OR ((( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) IS NOT NULL) AND storage.allow_only_operation('object.get_authenticated'::text) AND (( SELECT capi_amrigs_authorized() AS capi_amrigs_authorized) OR ( SELECT capi_amrigs_staff() AS capi_amrigs_staff)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (capi_amrigs_image_manifest m
     JOIN capi_training_questions q ON (((q.context = 'AMRIGS'::text) AND (q.editorial_status = 'human_reviewed'::text) AND q.student_visible)))
  WHERE (m.delivery_enabled AND (m.object_name = objects.name) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM jsonb_array_elements(
                CASE
                    WHEN (jsonb_typeof((q.body -> 'images'::text)) = 'array'::text) THEN (q.body -> 'images'::text)
                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                END) image(value)
          WHERE ((image.value ->> 'url'::text) = ('/amrigs/'::text || m.legacy_path)))))))))
